validator: independent validator, same reserved role as validation.json

claims.statement: TAWC lists September 9th, 2026, 8:30 to 11:30 a.m., at Lloyd and Angela Arthur's farm near Ralls.
claims.value_text: September 9, 2026. 8:30 to 11:30 a.m. 1102 Co Rd 135, Ralls, Texas.
claims.quote:
Wednesday, September 9, 2026
8:30 - 11:30AM
Lloyd & Angela Arthur farm
1102 Co Rd 135
Ralls, TX

claims.evidence_scope: Upcoming field day, not a completed demonstration. Block whitespace normalized.

claims.statement: Admission is free. The organizer offers equipment viewing and conversations with producers and researchers.
claims.source: Texas Alliance for Water Conservation event listing
claims.evidence_scope: Full September Field Day section read. Its following paragraph lists presentations, equipment operation, crop tour and discussion.

claims.statement: Texas Tech published the announcement on August 31st, 2026.
Autonomous Pivot is on the field-day program through a scheduled presentation by Daniel Jenkins.
claims.quote: Daniel Jenkins, vice president of sales and marketing for Autonomous Pivot, will discuss the company’s approach to automating irrigation.
claims.evidence_scope: Program listing, not evidence of new AP equipment on the Arthur farm.

claims.statement: Texas Tech identifies Lloyd Arthur as a Crosby County producer.
claims.quote: A Visit with Lloyd Arthur, Crosby County Producer - May 2020
claims.source: Texas Alliance for Water Conservation resources

claims.statement: TAWC's historical technical account describes reflected signals producing an additional soil-moisture estimate.
claims.quote: Proprietary algorithms analyze the reflected signal from the soil, remove noise, and provide a supplementary estimation for soil moisture.
claims.evidence_scope: Radar ahead of irrigation; signal-derived estimate, not root imaging or measured savings. Line-wrap whitespace normalized.

claims.statement: The newsletter describes crop-image and weather observations feeding estimated water use, soil-water estimates and irrigation recommendations.
claims.source: TAWC Spring 2024 newsletter, printed pages 3 and 4
claims.evidence_scope: Full sensor, water-balance, crop-coverage and recommendation paragraphs read. The excerpt preserves source language, but the film must not independently promise accuracy.

claims.statement: The vendor describes sensors mounted on existing irrigation pivots.
claims.evidence_scope: Better Decisions for Every Acre explains on-pivot observations. Treat as product description, not a new Arthur-farm installation.

claims.statement: The entire Texas Tech field-day announcement reports no measured water-saving result.
claims.source: Texas Tech Davis College full announcement
claims.evidence_scope: Validator re-read the entire article from headline through contact block. It announces activities and goals. It reports installation area for a different company and a producer count, but no measured water-saving result. This is an inference from full-document inspection, not a quotation asserting absence and not a claim that no study exists elsewhere.
claims.quote_scope_note: Exact phrase anchors the source's future-tense agenda. The quoted words alone do not establish absence; full-document review does.

claims.statement: The vendor describes analyzed observations becoming alerts and recommendations for irrigation decisions.
claims.quote: Field data is analyzed to deliver alerts, insights, and recommendations
claims.evidence_scope: Real-Time Insights section. Advice is supported; neither exclusive human control nor automatic nozzle commands are established.

claims.statement: The technical account used for the mechanism is the TAWC Spring 2024 newsletter.
claims.evidence_scope: Publication header in independently fetched full PDF extraction. Supports the year printed in credits; not a date of a new deployment.

rejected.claim: New Autonomous Pivot installation on Arthur farm
rejected.reason: Program listing does not establish installation.

rejected.claim: Measured farm water savings, yield gain, cost reduction or aquifer recovery
rejected.reason: No admitted outcome study establishes these claims.

rejected.claim: Automatic individual nozzle control on this farm
rejected.reason: Monitoring and recommendations do not establish actuation.

rejected.claim: Radar images roots or knows exact moisture everywhere

rejected.reason: Descriptive operator account is not comparative performance research.

rejected.claim: All field-day technologies are Autonomous Pivot functions
rejected.reason: Distinct speakers and systems appear on the program.

rejected.claim: The event listing explicitly labels its time Central
rejected.reason: Timezone is omitted; local-time interpretation is an inference.

evidence_policy: No invented numerical authorization list. Event values are transcribed from the organizer. Short quotes are exact, context is separately labeled, and scoped absence is explicitly an inference.
